metadata.title: Oracle, Adobe, and Macy's set to release earnings reports: What to Watch

content.text:
Oops, something went wrong
Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Thursday, Sept. 10, including earnings reports from Oracle (ORCL), Adobe (ADBE), and Macy's (M), in addition to data from the producer price index.
Time now for what to watch Thursday, September 10th. On the earnings front, Oracle set to report quarterly results.
The company has captured the attention of Wall Street as that stock has seen a recovery in recent weeks after a rough stretch this year.
The spotlight will be on Oracle converting its enormous AI related backlog into revenue.
Wall Street will also have its eyes set on financial results from Adobe and Macy's.
Adobe to provide a glimpse into how the software space is shaping up and if AI is proving to be a tailwind for that sector.
Meanwhile, Macy's will provide a line of sight into the health of the retail space and how consumers are spending amid rising costs.
Moving over to the housing front, existing home sales expected to slip for the month of August after declining in July.
There will also be an update on mortgage rates as it's been climbing amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.
On the inflation side, fresh data will be out for the producer price index, wholesale inflation expected to see a slight increase during the month of August, as well as year-over-year gains.
